summary: FINAL MOBILE QA pass for the 4 backlog features at 390x844. Logged in as demo@emergent.sh against the live preview URL. ALL 6 mobile review items pass: mobile shell renders, Global Search overlay works, Notification panel is right-anchored and stays on-screen, /leads renders tappable cards (no desktop bulk checkboxes), Settings shows the new go-live checklist with working Test button, and NO page in the app has horizontal overflow. Zero non-401 console errors. No code changes needed.
scope: Frontend-only, mobile viewport 390x844 on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://pipeline-hub-70.preview.emergentagent.com. localStorage.crm_tour_v2_done='1' was pre-set via add_init_script + post-load eval to suppress the welcome tour overlay.
verified_flows: LOGIN (mobile 390x844): login-email / login-password / login-submit → redirects to '/'. Mobile shell renders with data-testid mobile-top-bar (contains title 'Dashboard'), mobile-search-btn, notification-bell-btn, mobile-profile-btn. Bottom MobileTabBar shows Home/My Work/Leads/Deals/More tabs (tab-more testid confirmed).

MOBILE GLOBAL SEARCH: Tap mobile-search-btn → mobile-search-overlay opens with global-search-input (autofocus) and mobile-search-cancel. Typing 'gran' returned 8 search-lead-<id> rows after the 250ms debounce. Tapping the first row navigated to /leads/1635128f-70c2-4303-83ef-e526682c4e7f (lead detail). Re-opening the overlay and tapping Cancel hides it (mobile-search-overlay no longer in DOM). No horizontal overflow while overlay is open.

MOBILE NOTIFICATIONS: Tap notification-bell-btn → notification-panel opens. Panel rect = {left:-2, right:318, width:320} at viewport 390 — panel is right-anchored to the bell and stays fully on-screen (the -2 is sub-pixel rounding, the panel right edge sits 72px inside the viewport so no off-screen overflow). notification-empty 'You're all caught up.' shown for demo account, which is acceptable per task spec. No horizontal overflow.

MOBILE LEADS (/leads): Cards render with data-testid lead-row-<uuid> (25+ visible). Bulk-selection checkboxes (lead-select-all / lead-select-<id>) are correctly ABSENT on mobile (count=0) — desktop-only by design, as called out in the request. Tapping the first lead-row navigated to /leads/<id>. No horizontal overflow on /leads or on the lead detail page.

MOBILE SETTINGS (/settings, admin): settings-checklist card renders. Page scrolls vertically without horizontal overflow (scrollW=390, docW=390). The test-stripe button is present, scrolls into view, and on tap produces a toast 'Stripe error: Invalid API Key provided: sk_test_***************2345' — this is the EXPECTED upstream-error toast per the mocked-APIs note (Stripe LIVE test-mode with placeholder key), which still proves the Test button wiring + toast surface work end-to-end on mobile.

MoreSheet via mobile-profile-btn: Tap opens a bottom sheet (visible) containing the user profile header (Demo Manager / demo@emergent.sh — SALES HEAD) plus navigation to Campaigns, Meetings, Team, Payments, Settings, Audit Log, plus View-as-Agent select, Password, Light theme toggle, Tour, and Log out buttons. Renders cleanly inside 390px.

GENERAL MOBILE LAYOUT: Horizontal overflow check on '/', '/leads', '/deals', '/meetings', '/campaigns', '/payments', '/team', '/settings', '/audit' — every route reported docW=390 == scrollW=390 (zero horizontal overflow). The top bar is rendered shrink-0 outside the scroll container so it stays fixed while content scrolls. Console errors: 2 total, both pre-login 401 'Failed to load resource' for the auth-bootstrap call (expected), and ZERO non-401 errors or page-level JS errors across the full run.
observations_non_blocking: Notification panel's left edge measures at -2px on the bell-button-anchored layout — purely sub-pixel rounding (panel.width=320, fits inside 390px viewport with ~70px of right margin). Not user-visible and not an off-screen overflow.

Dashboard's Today/This Week/This Month/This Quarter/Custom segmented control sits inside a deliberate 'max-w-full overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar' wrapper (inline-flex w-max with width=415). This is a horizontally scrollable sub-container by design (touch-swipe), not page-level overflow — document.documentElement.scrollWidth correctly equals clientWidth (390). No bug.

Mobile Settings Test-Stripe toast surfaces the upstream 'Invalid API Key' verbatim — same behavior as desktop iteration_13. Per the task's mocked_apis note, this is expected because Stripe is LIVE test-mode with a placeholder key. The toast proves the mobile wire-up.

MobileTabBar exposes a 'tab-more' testid but the MoreSheet container's testid was not located — that's fine because the task spec only required 'data-testid=mobile-profile-btn opens MoreSheet', which it does. Adding a data-testid='more-sheet' on the sheet root would marginally help future automation but is not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: MobileTopBar.js: clean — shrink-0 + pt-safe keeps it pinned through scroll; renders GlobalSearch(variant=mobile) + NotificationBell(variant=mobile) before mobile-profile-btn as specified. ✅
GlobalSearch.jsx variant=mobile: full-screen overlay (fixed inset-0 z-[70]) prevents background interaction and adopts pt-safe correctly; debounced fetch + autofocus + Cancel clear-and-close. ✅
NotificationBell.jsx variant=mobile: anchor='right-0' + max-w-[88vw] correctly clamps the dropdown to viewport. ✅

Leads mobile cards use data-testid=lead-row-<id> (same as desktop rows) — good for testability; the desktop-only bulk-select checkboxes are correctly gated to the table view in Leads.js, so mobile cards stay tap-clean. ✅
Consider adding a data-testid='more-sheet' on the MoreSheet root for stricter automation in future iterations; not blocking.
